notes.title: Update #5
notes.content:
[p]Welcome to a new update for Homecoming, one of the last you'll see before the game is finished. There should be a total of three more updates: a new map, the final area of the game, and the ending(s) themselves, along with the corresponding tweaks after the testing phase.[/p][p]But now, let's get on with the update:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]New map
[/p][/*][/list][p]The second area hidden behind the mysterious doors is now revealed.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/f05a44361ac4ca7fa02ebe471e253dd89bf26f24.png"][/img][/p][p]It is an apparently abandoned area that you have accessed by elevator. Darkness surrounds you, but this time your flashlight works perfectly.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/31961d3ab060095b88112a21421c8db8664e2b39.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/41d1426a9430671e799fac58cf3b81e701f69629.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/7941fafa94ffe58464a17e80b6f2c0b56965c9f5.png"][/img][/p][p]Soon you will discover with your flashlight that you are not alone. You will face enemies you already know, but something may have changed.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/348106cbf4699f0e3cc92f640a78584f308a5f5c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/add4eed05085a66d4ff011c03f9f310a3faea393.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/af50a1946eb0fe9048fc0277f35b8369240ad82e.png"][/img][/p][p]Discover the secrets hidden in this new area as you try to stay alive and make sense of everything around you.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/141745bd57ee96b7d7bf79385b942bc0b9be45b2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/c646f5749a835a1a3ec92e6946d55beaf3a97e4b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/8119472ef99cc2fa582be9d9016deb8cda0a7f16.png"][/img][/p][p]Pay attention to the clues provided by your surroundings and be aware of your environment.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/a2d1e1b22101ced7cc8ca0e41ea20d0f6d1ce875.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]New interactive elements[/p][/*][*][p]New scenes dubbed into English and Spanish[/p][/*][*][p]Minor corrections to saving and loading areas[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As for the release date, I can't guarantee that it will be this year. I want to give you the best quality possible, so it will be released when it is completely finished.[/p][p]I hope you continue to keep your eyes on Homecoming!
[/p]

notes.title: Update #4
notes.content:
After the announcement that the game is delayed to the beginning of 2025, here are the news:

[list]
[*]New introduction for the story
[/list]
Until now, everything started directly in a strange room that led to the corridor of the house where most of the game takes place. 
I've added a bit of an introduction to the chaotic story, but you'll still have to figure out who you are and why you're there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/6db8aefc3eca6ea60780a70f63602937f5531292.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/3dcfdfaca1c27c09859117818a16e37a90035a92.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/c365e74503cd9d13f1b981a0b1a631279c20a0f4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/2160f4ff450ed244ee10a70ed6093f65d40993e3.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Rework of the main map
[/list]
There have been several modifications of the main map, changing old assets for some more modern ones that maintain the ambience.
One of the most significant cases is the window, which previously had a simple png texture and now implements exterior glass and rain materials.

BEFORE
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/2b5f711cf838ae4ef47ffbda0d064a89af71c43a.png[/img]

AFTER
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/362231e316673c19693c1a89e6dd5d5e7fcbf134.png[/img]
[list]
[*]New map
[/list]
We now have the first area hidden behind the mysterious doors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/ee15f868f025fd34c93f9c65f917a90430ef8106.png[/img]

It is a dark area, your flashlight has failed you but you are lucky, the candlelight lets you see enough to know that you are not alone. You will face a familiar type of enemy, watch your step.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/b9f43819d84131428fcb2043268bb8459c7ac54a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/b554a5bc90b0485471c965b2083fafd5f6ca4382.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/cae3ec11d8918be8310f45e2b440be82f2120bd6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/47ea887628c4af397f733973ad123fd3ad792bc6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/dc6dcc00deb19d8f42906b904cd9e0a86a801f3f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/166a955b327d1f8ab42cef9391153da642f1d517.png[/img]

Some items have been added to the map that will generate sound when you interact with them, so be careful how you use them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/e6b0448f858d2f0a42e982f85325858bafefb3a9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/c3e91c9044820ab46fa6d8c240d7d6b6507c0844.png[/img]

Pay close attention to everything around you, there could be clues and secrets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/bbfc42fb6f7bcd6cc5f7cc4d049ac0a1d6714889.png[/img]

[list]
[*]New dubbing
[/list]
The dubbing of the game in both Spanish and English is progressing normally, we are not professional actors so it is probably what is delaying the release of the game, but it is something fundamental in the story of Homecoming.

And I keep working to bring you the complete game with the best quality possible, I hope you keep supporting Homecoming. 
See you in 2025!

notes.title: Homecoming 2025
notes.content:
With great regret, I have decided to delay the release of Homecoming until the first quarter of 2025. The estimated date will be February 2025 but I will actually tell you that it will come out when it is really ready to come out.

The reason is that I don't want to release something incomplete, rushed parts or something that doesn't represent what this project is really about.
As the sole member of the project, I am putting all my heart into this game, but I also have other responsibilities and a job as a programmer.

By this I simply mean that I need a bit more time, but I'm still as excited as I was when I first thought about developing videogames.
In the next weeks you will have a new update and they will keep coming until the official release of the game.

I hope you understand and I want to wish you a happy holiday season, see you in 2025!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/70528095e9ca90f61d234c6fcb64142e495dae6c.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
I'm already preparing the final areas of the game that will lead to discovering the secret of the Dewey's story, not without making it a bit difficult of course.
I've decided not to reveal too much of what's new in these latest versions and let you discover it for yourselves, but here's something to get you warmed up:

[list]
[*]The dummies are back with a new AI and several surprises that you'll have to discover if you want to complete the game.
[/list]
Can you guess what you'll find behind these doors?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/cf7068af194f0cde1fa127a9c59859202472ebcc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/78a8993212c6007aaab82ad0670a3253fc4a3990.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/37481c4a218fc737f71233a783983624671b7c2c.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Key animations
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/a36142cae42f96832f30720a35566e8703a567d3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/ee15f868f025fd34c93f9c65f917a90430ef8106.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Phone takes centre stage (can't say much more)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/473c7b697b288dc2c882be0ed88e54e02bf1e9ef.gif[/img]

And finally there has been a pretty high optimization on load times and textures and there will be another one before release to get everything in place!
The rest of the stuff you'll have to find out, but it'll be worth the wait!

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
Welcome back! As you may know, the launch of Homecoming is just around the corner and I'm already finalizing details.

As I said in the previous update, the most significant change in this version is the new model and animations for the demon of our story, but I bring some more:

[list]
[*] New model and animations for the demon
[/list]
The old model and animations have been replaced with a new one.

We have a wide range of animations that will make you hold on to your chair, so I'm just going to leave you some of the previews :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/83a699b7f22110cd136c3cea3b15c43e86804802.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/9f5236e8bd8aedec61f505af5c802d9269c949b1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/ff79574ea48d07ceaec44cbae5249951a15019fb.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] New transition zone
[/list]
As the story progresses, you will see changes in the starting area of the game. This is the area where the player starts every time he dies or loads the game, and it will have some changes along the game.

[list]
[*] Loop 11
[/list]
New sound effects and lore have been added along with a note to continue the story.

[list]
[*] New transition scene
[/list]
Added a new scene that reconnects the outside of the game with the house

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/9a2b33e979fbd6a42c388c0cb049dbde6f46b985.png[/img]

Minor fixes

[list]
[*] Modified the way the dummies generated sound when chasing you to prevent them from generating infinitely.
[*] Fixed collisions
[/list]

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
I'm going to implement a new model for the demon with the intention of improving the realism and atmosphere of Homecoming and give it more prominence. Until now the model was quite poor and did not cause the terror that Homecoming seeks to provide. Here is a preview of what will be your worst nightmare:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/ba08f7776275153f69a0ac249c2ff00d18352cb4.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The graphic section of the VHS system has been implemented along with a new lore video inside the story.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/de92640683296e96d9924cdd30df1d37b385e448.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New interaction in the bathroom that replaces the old conversation.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added new loop after picking up the flashlight that adds lore and a new view of the place where the family murder was committed.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/7fb906848d522c220e835e2a7d53e4dafd53b2db.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Added mannequins on the roofs of the buildings in the final part of the outdoor scenery that add voices and lore to the story. And a little scare ;)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061531/7087cdfd8b73cf44017885a46c5c79bc0ddbb8bd.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Added sound effects in the menus.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added new animations in the “See” loop.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added hidden elements for steam achievements.
[/list]
[list]
[*] All texts so far have been translated and all Spanish voices have been recorded and implemented.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added new save in the outside area after the court scene. Now you don't have to watch it all the time if you are killed in that area.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Also it has been limited to once the times that you see the tutorials if you had died or loaded the game.
[/list]
[i][b]Fixes:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Changed the UI of picking up an object (it was confusing).
[/list]
[list]
[*] Changed the way to unlock the padlock. You must pick up the note to be able to open it and in each iteration the code changes.
[/list]
[list]
[*] AI and collision fixes
[/list]
[list]
[*] Modified some scares
[/list]
There have already been people who have been able to test the first part of the game and have given their feedback to help with the development of the game. There will still be another testing phase before the game is released so I encourage you to sign up.
